plainText:
Pop Roxie (Japanese: ホミカパパ Homika's Papa) is a character appearing in and the Pokémon Adventures manga. He is the father of the Virbank Gym Leader Roxie.

==In the core series games==
Pop Roxie is a sailor who runs a ferry between Virbank City and Castelia City. He is first seen arguing with his daughter in front of Virbank's Pokémon Center over his movie career, insisting that since Roxie is both a Gym Leader and a musician, he can be both a sailor and a movie star.

While he is auditioning at Pokéstar Studios, the gate to the studios cannot be entered until the obtains the . Upon entering Pokéstar Studios, the player watches Pop Roxie's first movie, Midlife Man of Justice vs. Brycen-Man of the Brycen-Man Series. As Riolu-Man, he ends up acting scared and being defeated. He later claims that one day, he will act once more. He then reopens his ferrying service.

===Pokémon===
====Pokéstar Studios====
Midlife Man of Justice vs. Brycen-Man
 
 
 
===Quotes===
Virbank City
Upon arriving in the city
"Roxie, don't try to stop me! I'm off to Pokéstar Studios to live up my true potential! My dream is to be a ship captain and a movie star!"
"Oh, dear daughter. You split your time between your responsibilities as a Gym Leader and with your band, right? I can do that, too!"

Pokéstar Studios
In the cinema
"Oh, if it isn't the scout himself! Thanks to you, I've made my movie debut!"
"And who would that be?"
"You beat Roxie, I see."
"You must be a pretty good Trainer. Oh, you know what? They're releasing my movie now! Are you thinking about making a Pokéstar Studios debut, too? Then, I do insist you watch my movie in order to gain acting tips from a professional such as myself."
"Awesome! Let's go!"
"This is where you choose the movie you want to watch. There are eight screens in the theater here in Pokéstar Studios! Pretty impressive, huh? Now... Huh? It seems my movie will be shown on a special screen."

In the movie
"Can you hold on, please?"
"The Messenger of Truth and Ideals, Riolu-Man enters! Hey there, Brycen-Man! It's not nice to do bad things!"
"I'm scared! "
"Yowch!"
"I wasn't hero material after all..."

After the movie
"..."
"..."
"Ha ha ha. I've always dreamed of making my debut on the silver screen..."
"Now I've fulfilled that dream..."
"Different people have different talents. I knew it all along. But I see my daughter striving to balance the responsibility of being a Gym Leader while pursuing her own dream of being in a band. Although I'm a father, I really wanted to pursue my own long-held dream... If you stop pursuing your dreams, your life might as well be over, right?"
"I'm going back to my duties as a ship captain for now. Someday, I'll return to the screen! Until that day comes, I'll leave all of the starring roles to you!"

Virbank City
After going to Pokéstar Studios
"So you saw it..."
"That movie was...No, it wasn't the movie. It was me. I was so excited that I didn't really become Riolu-Man! Acting like that won't thrill or excite anyone..."
"OK! I guess I'll do my best as a captain! I'll excite and thrill everyone by barreling through rough waves!"

Going to Castelia City for the first time:
"Of course! Please, step this away!"

Castelia City
Upon arriving
"Everyone, we've arrived at Castelia City!"

Castelia City/Virbank City
After first trip
"What can I do for you? Would you like to sail to City?"
Yes: "Of course! Please, step this way!"
No: "OK then! Please come to talk to me whenever you'd like to board!"

===Sprites===
 

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
Pop Roxie is mentioned in the Academy Founding Chapter event Explosive Art, Ninja's Craft by , who details to about his dream of becoming a movie star.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
Pop Roxie debuted in Choir Tournament. Roxie had her father take the students of the Aspertia City Trainers' School to Castelia City as a reward for winning the Autumn Choir Tournament. Roxie later revealed that her father once wanted to be a movie star and planned on giving up his job as a ship captain to do so. When Pop Roxie saw and 's performance at Pokéstar Studios, he realized that they were better than him and gave up.
